en-US.author: Mohamed Boudra
en-US.description: Self-hosted daemon for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, and Pi. Agents run on your machine with your full dev environment. Connect from phone, desktop, or web.
en-US.longDescription: One interface for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, and Pi agents. Run agents in parallel on your own machines, from your phone or your desk. Paseo runs a local daemon that manages your coding agents; the desktop app, mobile app, web app, and CLI all connect to it. Agents run on your machine with your full dev environment, using your tools, your configs, and your skills. Paseo does not use telemetry, tracking, or forced log-ins.
en-US.name: Paseo
en-US.releaseNotes:
0.15.2 - 2026-11-05
Added
- Added a first-run setup on Paseo Desktop and web that walks new users through theme, providers, projects, agent orchestration and the mobile app, with Settings → General → Show setup again to reopen it (#8363)
- Added project suggestions from the folders where you ran Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Pi, shown in the setup Projects step (#8363)
Improved
- Changed the theme picker to a grid of tiles with a preview of each theme (#8363)
- Replaced the "Loading…" text in Providers settings with skeleton rows (#8363)
- Changed controls to two sizes: default controls are 32px tall on desktop and 44px on phones, and compact controls are 28px (#8363)
- Changed first launch to go from the loading screen straight into setup instead of showing the empty home first (#8824)
- Changed dialogs on desktop and web to fade in over about 160ms (#8824)
- Changed modal and sheet backgrounds to match the screen background (#8363)
- Changed documentation links in Settings sections to a Label ↗ link beside the section title (#8363)

zh-CN.description: 用于 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、OpenCode 和 Pi 的自托管守护程序。智能体在您的机器上运行，拥有完整的开发环境。可从手机、桌面或网页连接。
zh-CN.longDescription: 为 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、OpenCode 和 Pi 智能体提供统一界面。在您自己的机器上并行运行智能体，无论在办公桌前还是手机上都能随时开始工作。Paseo 运行一个本地守护程序来管理您的编码智能体，桌面应用、移动应用、Web 应用和 CLI 均可连接。智能体在您的机器上运行，拥有完整的开发环境，可使用您的工具、配置和技能。Paseo 不含遥测、跟踪或强制登录。
